subject: general
question: Which of the following terms in the 5S concept refers to making a habit of maintaining 6 the established procedures?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sustain__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sustain__ is one of the five principles of the 5S methodology.
 
• Sustain refers to making a habit of maintaining the established procedures.
 
• The goal is to ensure consistency in following the practices over time.
 
• It requires employees to develop discipline and adhere to the procedures regularly.
 
• The sustainability principle ensures that improvements achieved through 5S are not temporary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sort:**

 
 
• Sort involves removing unnecessary items from the workspace.
 
• It focuses on decluttering to improve efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Set:**
 
 
• Set emphasizes organizing tools and materials for easy access.
 
• It aims to reduce time wasted searching for items.
 
 
 
• **Shine:**
 
 
• Shine involves cleaning the workspace to maintain hygiene and functionality.
 
• It helps in identifying issues such as wear and tear.
